verdict.rationale: The only route to natural-language operation is indirect: Stripe documents an official MCP server, which lets an AI agent drive Stripe through conversational commands. LLM-friendly docs (llms.txt and markdown pages) support this, but nothing shows Tax-specific tools in the MCP server or a built-in natural-language interface in the product. Missing for 10: evidence that the MCP server exposes Stripe Tax operations (calculations, registrations, reports), a native natural-language interface in Stripe Tax, and hands-on corroboration of natural-language tax workflows.
